value.rationale: The variance is a natural missing dispersion statistic for the invariant branching representation of the Have Your Cookie and Eat It walk. The exact threshold yields a genuine intermediate regime with finite stationary mean but infinite stationary variance, and an explicit pole at p=4/5. This is a complete natural parameter classification and closed formula, not an arbitrary numerical slice or routine re-expression of the known mean.
